about_short_description.short_description: Arab African International Leasing provides leasing services and solutions for of assets.

product.name: Capital Lease
product.description: A leasing agreement where the lessee obtains ownership rights of the leased asset after the lease term.

product.name: Operating Lease
product.description: A lease agreement where the lessee uses the asset for a specified period without ownership rights at the end of the lease.

product.name: Sale & Lease Back
product.description: A financial arrangement where an asset owner sells the asset and leases it back to continue using it while freeing up capital.

product.name: Tri-party Lease
product.description: A leasing contract involving three parties: the lessor, lessee, and a third party, defining asset use and payment terms.
